description: This is a PHP source file defining the ModuleService class, which manages modules in the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods for accessing and updating module data via a DAO.

classes.name: ModuleService
classes.description: Service class for managing modules, including retrieving module lists and updating their status.

methods.name: getModuleDao
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the ModuleDao instance used by this service.

methods.name: setModuleDao
methods.description: Sets the ModuleDao instance for this service.

methods.name: getModuleList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of modules from the database.

methods.name: updateModuleStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of modules based on the provided array.
